tool_args.rationale: The authorized mechanism notes and pilot signatures support endogenous adaptation, but the observations cover only H≤0.48. The recommended slow-horizon probe directly resolves the extrapolation ambiguity at the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow reversal reliably at H=20.7.
Additional fine short-horizon data would be less discriminating about the slow component.
The pilot has s_grad=0 throughout and cannot distinguish or calibrate its sink dependence.
